column1:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kankasanthurai to Matara via Mannar, Puttalam, Colombo and Galle during the evening or night.
Winds will be South-westerly. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.
Sea areas around the island will be slight.

Temporarily strong gusty winds (60-70 kmph) and very rough seas can be expected during
thundershowers.
